name: Spaced-repetition flashcards
summary: Flip cards, rate how well you remembered, and cards you missed return sooner while easy ones space out.
core_loop: see prompt → try to recall → flip to the answer → rate easy/hard/miss → card is rescheduled
rules: missed cards return in the same session
easy cards wait longer
a session ends when due cards are done
content_needs: decks of prompt and answer pairs
example_prompts: anki but with harry potter spells
a deck of my friends' birthdays and facts

name: Vocabulary pair matching
summary: Tap a word in one column and its meaning in the other to match pairs before time runs out.
core_loop: see two columns → tap a word then its translation → pair locks if right → clear the board
rules: a wrong pair flashes and costs time
cleared pairs disappear
social_hooks: race a friend on the same set
example_prompts: duolingo match but for spanish food words
match the french words to pictures

name: Typed translation
summary: A sentence in one language must be typed in another, accepting equivalent phrasings.
core_loop: read sentence → type translation → check → hearts lost on errors → next
rules: variants accepted via fuzzy match
wrong answer shows the correct one
example_prompts: duolingo style spanish lesson about travel
translate sentences from japanese to english
a french lesson with star wars sentences

name: Word-bank sentence builder
summary: Build the translation of a sentence by tapping words from a shuffled bank in the right order.
core_loop: read sentence → tap words in order → check → next
rules: words appear in a bank including decoys
tapping adds a word to the answer line
order must match an accepted translation
example_prompts: build the english sentence from the spanish one

name: Listening dictation
summary: A phrase is read aloud and the player types or orders what they heard.
core_loop: hear phrase → type it → compare → replay allowed once
rules: the phrase plays aloud
replay is allowed once
accents are lenient

name: Pronunciation check
summary: A phrase is shown and the player says it aloud, with a recognizer scoring how close it sounded.
core_loop: read phrase → speak → score → retry or next
rules: a phrase is shown
the recognizer returns a confidence
retries are allowed

name: Math fact speed drill
summary: Answer rapid arithmetic facts, with speed raising or lowering the next difficulty.
core_loop: see problem → type or tap answer → streak builds → harder facts
rules: facts adapt to accuracy
example_prompts: times tables race for third graders
math speed drill with a streak

name: Mental math chain
summary: A starting number is modified by successive operations shown one at a time, and the player enters the final result.
core_loop: see start → each step flashes → type the final number
rules: steps flash one at a time
the player holds a running total in mind
the final number is typed
example_prompts: add and subtract in your head with a timer

name: Fraction builder
summary: Shade bars or circles to build a given fraction or compare two fractions.
core_loop: see target fraction → shade pieces → check → compare
rules: a target fraction is given
shading parts of a bar or circle builds it
two fractions can be compared by area

name: Number line placement
summary: Drag a marker to where a number belongs on a line, learning magnitude.
core_loop: see number → place on line → get error → next
rules: a number appears
the player drags a marker to its position
scale may be linear or logarithmic
example_prompts: how big is a billion game

name: Balance scale algebra
summary: Keep a scale balanced by performing the same operation on both sides to isolate the unknown.
core_loop: see balanced equation → apply operation both sides → isolate x
rules: a scale shows both sides of an equation
the same operation must be applied to both sides
the goal is x alone on one side

name: Angle estimation
summary: An angle is shown and the player drags a ray to match or estimates its degrees.
core_loop: see angle → estimate → reveal error
rules: an angle is drawn
the player sets a ray to match or enters degrees
error in degrees is shown
win: low total error over the set
example_prompts: geometry angle practice with a protractor

name: Clock reading
summary: Read an analog clock or set the hands to a given time.
core_loop: see clock → type or set time
rules: an analog clock face shows a time or a target time is given
hour and minute hands are read or set separately
answers within a minute count

name: Periodic table match
summary: Match element symbols, names, numbers and groups, or place them on the table.
core_loop: see element → match property → place on table
rules: each card shows a symbol, name, number or group
pairs match across two columns or place on the table
wrong matches cost time
example_prompts: periodic table game for chemistry class

name: Balance the equation
summary: Adjust coefficients to balance atoms on both sides of a reaction.
core_loop: see equation → change coefficients → atoms counts match
rules: coefficients are adjusted with plus and minus
atom counts on each side must be equal
coefficients stay in lowest whole numbers

name: Label the diagram
summary: Drag labels to the matching parts of a diagram, such as a cell, plant or map.
core_loop: see diagram → drag labels → check
rules: a diagram has numbered drop zones
labels are dragged to the right zones
wrong labels bounce back
example_prompts: label the parts of a cell

name: Map pin quiz
summary: A place name is shown and the player taps its location on a map.
core_loop: read name → tap map → distance shown → next
rules: a place name is shown
tapping the map places a pin
distance from the true location is shown

name: Fill in the blank
summary: A sentence has a missing word that the player picks or types.
core_loop: read sentence → pick or type → next
rules: one word is missing
choices include decoys or the player types the word
explanations show after each
example_prompts: fill in the blanks with prepositions

name: Spot the error
summary: A sentence contains one error and the player taps the wrong word.
core_loop: read sentence → tap error → explanation
rules: each sentence has exactly one error
tap the wrong word
a rule note shows after each answer

name: Spell the word
summary: A word is spoken and the player types the spelling, with definition and use in a sentence as optional hints.
core_loop: hear word → type spelling → feedback
rules: the word is read aloud
a definition and example sentence can be requested
spelling must match

name: Typing lessons
summary: Type displayed text accurately and quickly, with accuracy and WPM shown.
core_loop: see text → type → accuracy and wpm
rules: text is shown above the input
errors are flagged live
speed and accuracy are both reported
social_hooks: race friends on the same text

name: Block coding puzzle
summary: Drag command blocks in order to make a character reach a goal.
core_loop: see goal → arrange blocks → run → fix
rules: blocks execute top to bottom
loops and conditions are unlocked gradually
a block limit makes efficient solutions
example_prompts: program a robot to reach the star

name: Logic gate circuits
summary: Connect logic gates to produce a required output for given inputs.
core_loop: see inputs and target → place gates → test
rules: inputs and a target output are given
gates are placed and wired
the circuit is tested against a truth table

name: Predict then simulate
summary: The player predicts the outcome of a physical scenario, then watches the simulation to compare.
core_loop: see setup → predict → run simulation → compare
rules: the setup is shown with options
the player commits before the simulation runs
the simulation then plays out to compare

name: Myth or fact
summary: Statements are shown and the player swipes true or false, learning the explanation after each.
core_loop: read statement → swipe → explanation
rules: each statement is true or false
an explanation shows after every swipe
a streak bonus rewards consecutive correct
example_prompts: fact check game for my class

name: Teach it back
summary: The player writes a short explanation of a concept, which is graded for key points.
core_loop: read concept → write explanation → score vs key points
rules: a concept is named
the player writes a short explanation
a rubric of key points is checked
example_prompts: teach a topic to a friend

name: Association memory
summary: The player places items in imagined locations to remember, then recalls them in order.
core_loop: see items → place in rooms → recall
rules: items are shown briefly
the player drops each item in a room of an imagined route
recall asks for items in route order
scoring: items recalled in the correct slot
example_prompts: memorize a shopping list by placing it in rooms

name: Unit conversion
summary: Estimate or convert between units, reinforcing scale.
core_loop: see question → answer
rules: a quantity in one unit is shown
the player types an estimate in another unit
answers within a tolerance count
example_prompts: estimate how many seconds are in a month

name: Read the chart
summary: A chart is shown and the player answers questions about it.
core_loop: view chart → answer → next
rules: a chart is generated from a data set
a question asks for a value, a trend or a comparison
one choice is correct
example_prompts: data literacy game with weather charts

name: Scenario triage
summary: A scenario is described and the player chooses the best action, learning from consequences.
core_loop: read scenario → choose → feedback
rules: a scenario is described in a few lines
the player picks among actions
consequences and the best action are explained
example_prompts: safety training game for new hires

name: Valid or invalid
summary: Arguments are shown and the player decides if the conclusion follows.
core_loop: read argument → valid or invalid
rules: two premises and a conclusion are shown
the player says whether the conclusion must follow
an explanation shows after each answer
example_prompts: logic reasoning practice with funny arguments

name: Probability odds
summary: Simulate chance events and estimate probabilities.
core_loop: see setup → estimate → run trials
rules: a random setup such as dice, cards or doors is shown
the player estimates a probability
a simulation of many trials shows the empirical result
scoring: error between estimate and true probability
example_prompts: guess the odds then see 1000 trials

name: Script stroke trace
summary: Trace characters of a new script in the right stroke order.
core_loop: see character → trace
rules: a ghost character shows stroke order
strokes must be drawn in order and direction
accuracy depends on distance to the ghost
win: trace the set with accuracy above target

name: Live class quiz
summary: A host runs a quiz and everyone answers on their phone, earning points for speed.
core_loop: host question → everyone answers → leaderboard
rules: the host starts each question for everyone at once
faster correct answers score more
a leaderboard shows after each question
example_prompts: kahoot style quiz for my study group
blooket for our family trivia night

name: Sentence unscramble
summary: Reorder shuffled words into a grammatical sentence.
core_loop: drag words
rules: words are shuffled
the player drags them into a grammatical order
several valid orders may be accepted
example_prompts: put the words in order for english class

name: Budget decisions
summary: Allocate a monthly income across needs, wants and savings, then handle surprise events.
core_loop: see income → allocate → events hit → month ends → see savings
rules: income is split across needs, wants and savings
random events add costs or bonuses
each decision has a consequence shown immediately
win: end the month with savings above the goal
lose: run out of money before the month ends
example_prompts: personal finance sim with surprise bills
